# Loading necessary packages:



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
# Load libraries
pacman::p_load(tidyverse,jsonlite,
               SmartEDA,tidygraph,
               ggraph)
```
:::



# Use fromJSON to import data:



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
kg <- fromJSON("MC1_graph.json")
```
:::



# Inspect structure:



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
str(kg, max.level=1)
```

::: {.cell-output .cell-output-stdout}

```
List of 5
 $ directed  : logi TRUE
 $ multigraph: logi TRUE
 $ graph     :List of 2
 $ nodes     :'data.frame':	17412 obs. of  10 variables:
 $ links     :'data.frame':	37857 obs. of  4 variables:
```


:::
:::



# Extract and Inspect:



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
nodes_tbl <- as_tibble(kg$nodes)
edges_tbl <- as_tibble(kg$links)
```
:::



# Initial EDA:



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggplot(data = edges_tbl,
       aes(y = `Edge Type`)) +
  geom_bar()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In_class_exercise_3_files/figure-html/EDA -1.png){width=672}
:::
:::



# step 1: mapping from node id to row index



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
id_map <- tibble(id = nodes_tbl$id,
                 index = seq_len(
                   nrow(nodes_tbl)))
```
:::



# step 2: Ma source and target ids to row indices



::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
edges_tbl <- edges_tbl %>%
  left_join(id_map, by = c("source" = "id")) %>%
  rename(from = index) %>%
  left_join(id_map, by = c("target" = "id")) %>%
  rename(to = index)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
graph <- tbl_graph(nodes = nodes_tbl,
                   edges = edges_tbl,
                   directed = kg$directed)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
set.seed(1234)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggraph(graph, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(alpha = 0.3, colour = "gray") +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = `Node Type`), size = 4) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name),
                 repel = TRUE,      # R’s logical constant
                 size = 2.5) +
  theme_void()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In_class_exercise_3_files/figure-html/4-1.png){width=672}
:::
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
library(tidygraph)
library(ggraph)
library(ggrepel)
library(dplyr)

graph_memberof <- tbl_graph(
  nodes    = nodes_tbl,
  edges    = edges_tbl,
  directed = FALSE
)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
used_node_indices <- graph_memberof %>%
  activate(edges) %>%
  as_tibble() %>%
  select(from, to) %>%
  unlist(use.names = FALSE) %>%
  unique()
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
filtered_graph <- graph_memberof %>%
  activate(nodes) %>%
  filter(row_number() %in% used_node_indices)
```
:::

::: {.cell}

```{.r .cell-code}
ggraph(filtered_graph, layout = "fr") +
  geom_edge_link(alpha = 0.5, colour = "gray") +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = `Node Type`), size = 3) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name),
                 repel = TRUE,
                 size = 3) +
  theme_void()
```

::: {.cell-output-display}
![](In_class_exercise_3_files/figure-html/8-1.png){width=672}
:::
